script = '''
import openpyxl
import json

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook("CUGA_generalist_agent/.cuga/env/testbed/data/order_summary.xlsx", data_only=True)

all_data = {}
for sheet_name in wb.sheetnames:
    ws = wb[sheet_name]
    sheet_data = []
    for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=1, max_row=ws.max_row, max_col=ws.max_column, values_only=False):
        row_data = []
        for cell in row:
            val = cell.value
            if val is not None:
                row_data.append({"cell": cell.coordinate, "value": str(val)})
            else:
                row_data.append({"cell": cell.coordinate, "value": ""})
        sheet_data.append(row_data)
    all_data[sheet_name] = {
        "max_row": ws.max_row,
        "max_col": ws.max_column,
        "rows": sheet_data
    }

print(json.dumps({"sheets": list(all_data.keys()), "summary": {k: {"rows": v["max_row"], "cols": v["max_col"]} for k, v in all_data.items()}}))

# Build a readable text output
lines = []
for sheet_name, info in all_data.items():
    lines.append(f"=== Sheet: {sheet_name} (Rows: {info['max_row']}, Columns: {info['max_col']}) ===")
    lines.append("")
    # Header row
    if info["rows"]:
        headers = [c["value"] for c in info["rows"][0]]
        # Determine column widths
        col_widths = [len(h) for h in headers]
        for row_cells in info["rows"][1:]:
            for i, c in enumerate(row_cells):
                col_widths[i] = max(col_widths[i], len(c["value"]))
        # Print header
        header_line = " | ".join(h.ljust(col_widths[i]) for i, h in enumerate(headers))
        lines.append(header_line)
        lines.append("-" * len(header_line))
        # Print data rows
        for row_cells in info["rows"][1:]:
            vals = [c["value"] for c in row_cells]
            lines.append(" | ".join(v.ljust(col_widths[i]) for i, v in enumerate(vals)))
    lines.append("")

output_text = "\\n".join(lines)
with open("order_summary_extracted.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write(output_text)

print("\\nFile written successfully.")
print("\\n--- Preview ---")
print(output_text[:3000])
'''
await write_file("./extract_excel.py", script)
print("Script written.")

result = await run_command("python ./extract_excel.py")
